# Tusk

> Agent memory you can code-review. Tusk indexes a folder of markdown into a typed, searchable graph that agents query over MCP (`tusk mcp`, stdio) or the `tusk` CLI. The memory stays plain files in git; `tusk doctor` exits 1 when a link dangles, a property breaks the schema, or a declared rule matches.

Tusk is a single Go binary. A markdown file is a node when its YAML frontmatter has `type:`; its path without the extension is its id. `tusk.toml` declares node types, properties, edge types and rules. The index is a SQLite file in `.tusk/` (gitignored, rebuilt by `tusk reindex`). Semantic and hybrid search need Ollama running locally; structural queries, doctor and the web app don't. The MCP server finds its workspace by walking up from its working directory to the nearest `tusk.toml`, or from the directory `--workspace` (or `TUSK_WORKSPACE`) names.

## Start here

- [Everything in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/llms-full.txt): the README, every guide and the whole CLI reference joined, for one fetch
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/README.md): what tusk is, install, a quickstart, per-client MCP setup, and the setup steps for agents
- [Install and update](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/install.md): install script, `go install`, building from source, `tusk update`

## Guides

- [Workspaces, nodes and the manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/workspace.md): node files, edges, wikilinks, path refs, `tusk.toml`, type packs, what gets indexed
- [Querying](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/querying.md): the filter grammar, semantic and hybrid search, matched units with line ranges, embedding model settings
- [Rules and doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/rules-and-doctor.md): severities, exit codes, `[rule.<name>]` conventions, running doctor in CI
- [MCP server and Claude Code plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/mcp.md): the server, `tusk claude install`, the `tusk_*` tool list
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/guide/benchmarks.md): tool calls, input tokens, time and accuracy for an agent answering with `tusk_query` against grep and read

## CLI reference

- [Command index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/cli/README.md): every command, generated from the CLI help text
- [Workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/cli/workflows.md): multi-command recipes (bootstrap, ingest, query, MCP wiring, health checks)
- [tusk query](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/cli/tusk_query.md): structural, semantic and hybrid queries
- [tusk doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/germanamz/tusk/main/docs/cli/tusk_doctor.md): health check flags and exit codes
